name: konstruktoid
description: Reusable authoring standards for AI coding agents: skills with a bounded verify-fix loop, plus the instructions documents they build on.

plugins.name: python-standards
plugins.description: Python authoring standards: the ruff/ty quality gate, security practices aligned to the OWASP Top 10:2025, and pytest coverage that matches the target repository's existing test layout. Each skill runs a bounded verify-fix loop and reports unresolved findings rather than declaring success unverified.

plugins.name: ansible-standards
plugins.description: Ansible authoring standards: review and modify roles, collections, playbooks, and tasks, verified through the target repository's own lint and test loop rather than declaring success from the edit alone.
